newsitem.title: USA: Royal Gold stake cut by Cortez group.
newsitem.headline: Royal Gold stake cut by Cortez group.

text.p: A group including Cortez Gold Mines and Placer Dome Inc said Thursday it reduced its stake in Royal Gold Inc to 635,965 common shares or 4.1 percent from 5.1 percent held previously.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it sold 154,800 common shares on January 20 at a price of $10.50 per share.
The group said that Cortez plans to sell 35,965 additional common from time to time, not to exceed more than one percent of the outstanding shares of Royal Gold within any three-month period.
